test_function_signatures: test pybind11 bound function signatures to verify correct docstring output for keyword arguments
test_named_arguments: test calling pybind11 functions with named keyword arguments and default values
test_arg_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions that accept variadic args and kwargs via star unpacking
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions combining positional args, variadic args, kwargs, and defaults
test_args_refcount: test pybind11 reference counting behavior when mixing regular arguments with py::args
